text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Manhattan Cafe and I had an
honest
exchange about our hopes at the
airport, our
bond is stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Slowly but surely, she's bouncing back
from
despair and seems to be smiling
more than she
used to as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a little past dawn, and we're at
Hanshin
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... The stage for
our new
beginning...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Manhattan Cafe back on a
domestic track, we set our sights firmly
on reaching the top of the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's rival is...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The view from the lead is mine. And
mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka. A racer known for her

otherworldly speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's broken away and left the
competition in the dust countless times,
seizing victory after victory. A powerful
opponent who races not to conquer her
rivals but to surpass all limits.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This view... is going to stay mine.
There's
no one
in front of me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
it's my friend... She's in front of
Silence
Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What? But she isn't. There's nobody.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, so she doesn't disappear... just
because
you're apart. She's almost like a
searchlight, or a
fishing line...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. This is truly fascinating, and
yet, more
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Take a look, Trainer. Feast your eyes on
Cafe's
condition!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her cardiovascular and pulmonary health
are in
good shape! Even the air around
her seems to
simmer with energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a good look at Manhattan Cafe.
The results
of canceling her international
trip are crystal
clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We shifted gears and put ourselves on
track for
success here. Now I can support
her free of
concern.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, today's the day. Your new
frontier's
waiting for you. Our Plan B...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Realize that potential! Show me what's
beyond
the limits! Leave everything and
everyone in the
dust!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: In the dust? That's no place for me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Where I belong... is in the lead.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Silence Suzuka...
She's a little different
from
what I've heard...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I heard she was reserved, but there's a

earth-shattering intensity lurking
there...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(My friend's saying the same thing. "Go
beyond
her, and come to me...")

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though no words are exchanged, sparks
are
flying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka has taken the lead... Will

Manhattan Cafe get a glimpse at what
lies
beyond her limits?
